scope: Two explicitly inspected device-context clear/init hunks, original and merge-parent diffs. Actual retained-state EP0 schedules plus scoped unit cancellation/admission checks, not complete lifecycle/IRQ/erasure acceptance.

reviews.assessment: Only device_init/context-clear addition: initialize context owner to NONE; main-loop lifecycle clear resets applet context and releases USB reservations after old endpoint epoch invalidation. Rust composition serializes WebUSB/HID/CCID cleanup, Core::reset closes/aborts response/input and resets router/auth/owner; Registry clears selection and grants. E50/E55 verify old-source rejection and PIN revocation. New WebUSB deferred initialization retains status but blocks command/response until cleanup; executing cancellation stays immediate. Adjacent reservation/CAS code and full IRQ/resource acceptance remain unreviewed/open.

source_review.observed: Init/DeInit IRQ callbacks publish lifecycle epoch without WebUSB initialization. Service clears session/Core, initializes WebUSB, then applies interfaces and acknowledges unchanged epoch. Old class state is visible to EP0 status before service, while session acquisition refuses commands/responses.

Init sets IDLE; SetupAborted only clears RECVING/SENT_RESP, so ready-response/Hold persist across global deferred transition until Service. Command/response acquisition still enforces readiness. E55 runs actual control stages with retained state.
Main-loop device_applet_session_clear resets applet context/owners and releases USB buffers. Only historical clear/init hunk mapped here, not surrounding CAS/sentinel/lifecycle functions.
